items.description:
* Provided expert guidance to customers in selecting appropriate tools and equipment, ensuring their needs were met and projects were successful.

* Offered comprehensive product knowledge and assisted customers in navigating the store's inventory, enhancing their shopping experience.

* Efficiently processed transactions at the register, maintaining accuracy and speed while adhering to company policies.

* Addressed customer inquiries and resolved issues promptly, contributing to a positive and customer-centric environment.

* Designed and developed custom websites for small businesses, tailored to their specific needs and target audiences.

* Collaborated directly with clients to understand their business objectives and translate them into effective online solutions.

* Implemented responsive and user-friendly website designs using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

* Managed all aspects of website development, including front-end and back-end development, content integration, and deployment.

* Provided ongoing website maintenance and support, ensuring optimal performance and security.

* Developed and maintained websites and web applications, ensuring optimal performance and user experience.

* Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate design concepts into functional and engaging web interfaces.

* Implemented front-end and back-end solutions using React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Firebase/Firestore.

* Engineered a dynamic React table that efficiently streamed, queried, and searched data from Firestore, significantly improving data accessibility and user interaction.

* Conducted thorough testing and debugging to identify and resolve technical issues, ensuring website stability and reliability.

items.name: Mechanical Aptitude and Maintenance Experience
items.description:
* Demonstrated strong mechanical aptitude through the successful installation of cat-back, axle-back exhaust systems, and headers showcasing proficiency in automotive modification.

* Performed routine vehicle maintenance, including oil and filter changes, tire rotations, and general inspections, ensuring optimal vehicle performance and longevity.

* Experienced in the installation of headers, highlighting advanced automotive repair knowledge and practical skills.

* Possess an understanding of automotive systems and a commitment to meticulous workmanship.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions and utilize various tools effectively to complete complex mechanical tasks.
